turns.prompt_text: how do I determine my skin type I know I have oily skin
turns.response_html:
To confirm your skin type beyond your oily areas, use the "Wash and Wait" method:

  1. Cleanse: Wash your face with a mild, pH-balanced cleanser and gently pat it dry.
  2. Wait: Leave your skin bare (no toners, serums, or moisturizers) for one hour.
  3. Observe: Check your face in a mirror and feel the texture.

Identifying the Results

  • Oily: Your entire face looks shiny and feels greasy to the touch.
  • Combination: Your "T-zone" (forehead, nose, and chin) is oily, but your cheeks feel tight or dry.
  • Dry: Your skin feels tight, looks flaky, or appears dull across the entire face.
  • Sensitive: Your skin becomes red, itchy, or irritated after washing.
